items.question: What duration of properly accomplished twilight-worship results from employing that prior method?
premises: The previously described method is employed.
A span of twelve years is specified.
items.inference: Employing that prior method results in twelve years of properly accomplished twilight-worship.
items.plain_english: By that method, twilight-worship becomes well accomplished for twelve years.
